about.headline: Design That Does Good
about.page_subheadline: A small studio with a clear point of view.
about.body: Verdant was founded on the belief that design is a powerful force for good.
about.mission_body_1: We started Verdant because purpose-led businesses deserve brands that reflect their ambition.
about.mission_body_2: We're a small, focused studio. We take on fewer clients so we can go deeper with each one.
about.team_subheadline: Small by design. Committed by choice.

values.title: Purpose Over Profit
values.body: We work with businesses trying to make things better.

values.title: Craft First
values.body: Every curve, every colour, every word is considered.

values.title: Open Collaboration
values.body: The best work comes from genuine partnership.
